audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere; tldr called Karma 'he'; dontsFull[2] title said 'Ult a target with escapes still up' but its body was recycled Q-whiff text.
audit.why: Kit file: Focused Resolve (W) is a flat 12s at every rank, 675 range; Death's Grasp (E) is 16/14/12/10/8s at 700 range; Realm of Death is 140/120/100s; Inner Flame (Q) is 950 range on 9/8/7/6/5s; Inspire (E) is 800 range on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s; Mantra is 40/38/36/34s. Karma has no dash, so the Q grounding flag is irrelevant here.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon and dontsFull[2].d now state the flat 12s root, the E pull and the 140/120/100s R timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization never mentioned Grievous Wounds despite the flagged anti-heal need.
audit.why: Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals Karma while it roots, which is what stalls your extended aura grind.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now names Grievous Wounds against Mantra-W's self-heal and Mercury's Treads against the 12s root.

audit.why: Packet flagged whys[2] 'Her Focused Resolve' as a probable wrong ability name. It is the real name of Karma's W in the kit file — false positive, left alone.

edits.before: He kites your slow kit — E-pull the step-up, then drag him into the Realm where he can't run. Mordekaiser wins by trading around Karma's Focused Resolve and cashing the pattern: pull his misstep and win the Realm 1v1.
edits.after: She kites your slow kit — Death's Grasp (E) pulls her step-up, then the Realm takes her somewhere she can't kite. Focused Resolve is a flat 12s: bait the root, pull her in, and win the 1v1 while it's down.

edits.before: Pull his misstep and win the Realm 1v1. Track Focused Resolve before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s — never spend it while her Mantra shield and Focused Resolve are up, or she stalls the duel out and walks away healthy.

edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment (burn beats her shields), then Riftmaker; boots Mercury's Treads for her 12s root. Grievous Wounds cuts Mantra-W's self-heal.

notes: Level chart was inverted on every row in both layers; fixed in matched pairs per the packet and the karma__mordekaiser mirror.
